en-US.shortDescription: A research memory copilot that captures decisions, audits reproducibility, and governs changes.
en-US.fullDescription: Experiment Guardian turns laboratory discussions into traceable experiment records. Ask Alexa+ to begin a documentation session, record observations and decisions, investigate reproducibility findings, and propose structured changes. Its remote MCP tools keep evidence, deterministic audits, and approval state in the Experiment Guardian service. Every proposed change is read back and requires explicit approval before it is applied.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Experiment Guardian to start documenting my experiment
Alexa, tell Experiment Guardian that we changed the learning rate to point zero zero one
Alexa, ask Experiment Guardian to investigate the missing random seed

carouselImages.altText: Experiment Guardian research copilot with evidence and approval workflow
